title: feat('error handling'): Add a SearchError widget
body:
We should provide a widget to allow devs to display an error message to their users when something's gone wrong internally (network error/API error).

Not sure yet about the interface/options it should have... any ideas @vvo?

comments.body: I think it's good to have a widget for errors. However I would (as a developper) like to have a way to integrate such error feedback in my programmatic js (to implement popups logic or conditionnally display part of an instantsearch UI), which seems awkward with a widget. How do you think it could work @olance ?
@bobylito coupled with the event in #1585, do you think you'd need more?
Do we need both? How the use cases for each distinguishes?

I think @vvo sees #1585 as a quick fix for the fact that we currently have no easy error handling in instantsearch.js... and the widget as a nice/convenient way to display an error when you're not doing too low-level things.

At least that's how I see it...
To me it's kind of the same as having a `render` event and a `hits` widget :)

Humm not really the `render` event let you do stuff at a given time. The `hits` widget let you display results...

Ok for letting you display an error message with a declarative API using a widget 👍

Hmm well wouldn't the `error` event let you do stuff at a given time (ie. error occurred) while the `error` widget would let you display errors?

Not trying to troll here but I don't see your point!

> Hmm well wouldn't the error event let you do stuff at a given time (ie. error occurred) while the error widget would let you display errors?

No troll taken ;) I was just comparing hits vs render event with error event vs error widget. IMHO the error mechanism will let you do the same stuff, whereas the render event has a different purpose than the hits widget. That's details though :)

> I see it as a developer tool rather than a production tool.

For me too! And I agree with @vvo
hmm I guess it works indeed :)

Actually right now errors are not part of the widgets lifecycle: I propose we move on with the event and drop the idea of the widget for the moment. Feel free to reopen the issue or create a new one. Thanks 🙇
